headline: Can Trade Desk Stock Bounce Off Its Old Support Again?
summary: Investors holding Trade Desk (TTD) have seen the stock lose 74.1% of its value over the past year, compared with a 17.9% return for the S&P 500. The immediate question is how much further shares might drop. One certainty is the current level: at $13.13 on October 15, the stock sits above the prices where it turned and rallied three times in 2018. How did the stock fare at this price then, and how has it fared in 2026.
